senses.gloss:
a. Wishing, desiring &c. 
-कः 
__1 (In Arith.) The sum sought. 
__2 N. of a tree; Shaddock, which is a large species of orange; citrus, Medica (Mar. महाळुंग).
N. of a tree, the citron.
pres. p. Wishing, desirous, willing; अनिच्छन्नपि वार्ष्णेय बलादिव नियोजितः [[Bg. 3. 36.]] अनिच्छतोऽपि तस्य against his will.

[इष् भावे श] 
__1 Wish, desire, inclination of mind, will; इच्छया according to one's desire, at will. 
__2 Willingness. 
__3 (In Math.) A question or problem. 4 (In gram.) The form of the Desiderative. 
-Comp. 
-दानम् fulfilment of a wish. 
-निवृत्तिः f. suppression of desire, indifference to worldly desires. 
-फलम् the solution of a question or problem. 
-रतम् desired sports, favourite pastimes; नीता रात्रिः क्षणमिव मया सार्धमिच्छारतैर्या [[Me. 89.]] 
-रूपम् 
__1 Desire (personified). 
__2 The first manifestation of divine power. 
-वसु a. 'possessing wealth according to wish', epithet of Kubera. 
-संपद् f. fulfilment of one's wishes.
a. [बिन्दुरिच्छुः [[P. III. 2. 169.]]] Wishing, desirous; usually in comp. इच्छुः कामयितुं त्वं माम् … [[Bk. 5. 59.]]
